name: Warren Commission Report
description: The 888-page report (with 26 volumes of evidence) concluding Oswald acted alone in killing President Kennedy. Both the foundational official record and, for critics, the foundational text to be picked apart — beginning the modern era of official-report skepticism.

name: Zapruder Film
description: Abraham Zapruder's 26-second 8mm home movie of the Kennedy assassination — the most analysed piece of film in history, whose frame 313 and head-motion physics have powered arguments on all sides for decades.

name: Pentagon Papers
description: The Defense Department's secret history of Vietnam decision-making, leaked by Daniel Ellsberg, showing successive administrations misled the public about the war. Alongside Watergate, the era's proof that official narratives could conceal documented deception.

name: Operation Northwoods Memoranda
description: Joint Chiefs documents proposing staged pretexts for war with Cuba — hijackings, fabricated attacks — rejected by civilian leadership. The most-cited authentic document in false-flag debates, and routinely stretched past what it proves.

name: Church Committee Reports
description: Fourteen Senate reports documenting CIA assassination plots, MKUltra, NSA watchlists, and COINTELPRO — the largest official confirmation of real intelligence-agency abuses, and the source that permanently changed the prior on 'they would never'.

name: Majestic 12 Documents
description: Film-roll 'briefing documents' naming a Truman-era UFO committee. Declared bogus by the FBI; typographic anachronisms and a transplanted Truman signature identify them as fabrications — the most consequential forgery in UFO history.

name: Protocols of the Elders of Zion
description: Antisemitic forgery fabricated in Tsarist Russia, plagiarized from a French satire, purporting to record a Jewish plot for world domination. Exposed by The Times in 1921 yet endlessly republished; the deadliest conspiracy document ever produced, and the ancestral template of 'hidden elite' narratives.

name: Report from Iron Mountain
description: A hoax 'leaked government study' arguing peace would destabilize society — written as satire by Leonard Lewin, who confessed in 1972. Still circulated as authentic in militia literature; the canonical case of satire escaping its frame.

name: WikiLeaks Diplomatic Cables
description: A quarter-million leaked State Department cables revealing candid diplomacy. Their authenticity and impact made 'the documents will come out' a live expectation — energizing both legitimate transparency work and the assumption that every theory awaits its leak.

name: JFK Assassination Records Releases
description: Under the 1992 JFK Records Act — passed in response to Oliver Stone's film — millions of pages have been progressively declassified, with final tranches in the 2020s. The releases have enriched context (CIA monitoring of Oswald) without documenting a plot, and each remaining redaction sustains the story.
